lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 8 visible high-contrast vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-lateral flank, with slight compression toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior-most line is truncated, terminating before reaching the mid-flank; posterior-most lines show significant ventral tapering and loss of contrast.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate spiral; horns diverge laterally at approximately 60 degrees from the cranial base before curving medially and dorsally at the terminal ends.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 2.1:1 ratio of pixel distance between horn tips relative to the collective pixel width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 12-15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white dorsal crest of elongated hair extending from the nape to the rump.
